title: Federal standards.
bodyText: The department of agriculture and biosecurity may adopt the federal grade standards for the grading of beef, pork, mutton and lamb.
bodyHtml: §147-92  Federal standards.  The department of agriculture and biosecurity may adopt the federal grade standards for the grading of beef, pork, mutton and lamb. [L 1955, c 272, §2; RL 1955, §22-91; am L 1957, c 172, §1(b); am L Sp 1959 2d, c 1, §22; am L 1961, c 132, §2; HRS §147-92; am L 2025, c 236, §17]
